title: Armor pickups (mail shirt in the Barrow Crypt) show an explicit '(You will wear it now.)' notice, but weapon pickups that also clearly auto-equip (the plain sword at the Forge which changed my hit bonus via Keen Edge; the Free Company blade from Rook which became my listed combat weapon) never showed the parallel '(You will fight with it now.)' notice at any point in this run.
where: The Forge - 'take the plain sword from the wall'; The Rope Larder - Rook's blade reward
